review: Claude Opus5.5 medium; tools/MCP/hooks disabled; local supplied design only
accepted: Positive exact ideal chart triangles plus full oriented physical border chains provide the planar degree/tiling argument, including holes. Actual surface embedding and tetrahedron positivity remain independent gates.

Whole-face mapping requires a displacement bound as well as a plane-normal error. ComponentPointError adds the original ideal model-to-authoritative-plane offset to actual-to-original L1 displacement.
Retain simultaneous physical junction constraints, exact original feature parameters, complete cavity closure and atomic publication.
qualified_or_not_adopted: The proposed changing-wall-footprint hash does not fit this implementation: CBoundaryLayerMetric::FromNativeReference copies immutable ReferenceState.facets coordinates/connectivity into faceted wall data. It does not rebuild wall bases from the accepted boundary parameter table. A new facade sharing the exact immutable MappedFacetReference authority has the same original geometry, mapping contract, policy and version. Keep strict original-mesh/donor/selected-field/config eligibility. Reallocated authorities conservatively refuse reuse.
Original physical border vertices remain protected in this batch; coarsening across their collinear event chains is not newly supported.
The review does not establish finite-body source coverage, actual embedding, construction feasibility, restart, MPI consistency or performance.
